rationale: This mutation bridges the -$18.3k cash deficit by transforming Oracle Front-Run into an active peak-arbitrage node that routinely liquidates surplus shed inventory at cyclical price premiums (>=1.05x base price), while extending 2.0x-3.5x Town Shop deliveries through Day 30. It dismantles the capital reinvestment deadlock by lowering the hiring hurdle to an accessible $75 buffer to front-load a 10-hand workforce by Day 4-5, inverting land expansion to trigger when plots are fully cultivated (uncultivated_plots <= 1) up to 26 contiguous plots, and purging the phantom 4-unit Wheat reserve when holding zero livestock. Worker dispatch is streamlined around localized plot clusters with immediate shed deposit routing, while crop seed procurement is strictly aligned with maturation cycles (halting Pumpkins on Day 26, Tomatoes on Day 27, and Carrots on Day 28) to prevent stranding capital at game close.
